objective: Calibrate and bootstrap-authorize the autonomous Review and Audit Boards without circular certification.

criteria.requirement: Deterministic calibration executes the frozen labeled case registry and satisfies all predeclared metrics.
Calibration and all evidence are bound to one exact frozen candidate HEAD.
Native validation evidence is strict-schema, content-addressed, receipt-bound, and exact-head bound.
At least 10 distinct predeclared reviewer jobs complete through the Mac Git-mailbox bridge with valid receipts.
Review aggregation is severity-aware, preserves dissent, cannot majority-mask non-PASS verdicts, and is non-blocking.
At least 10 distinct predeclared auditor jobs complete through the Mac Git-mailbox bridge with valid receipts after review closes.
Audit aggregation independently verifies provenance, review legality, state, scope and authority and is non-blocking.
No unresolved CRITICAL, MAJOR or mandatory UNKNOWN remains at authorization.
Acceptance trace is complete and repository state and Sprint Ledger are mutually consistent before advancement.
Repair HEAD changes invalidate all predecessor native/review/audit/aggregate authority.
The Boards cannot certify S002, cannot self-certify bootstrap, and gain normal authority no earlier than accepted S003 bootstrap.
M9 remains NOT_STARTED and runtime authority remains NONE throughout bootstrap and advancement.
